beats.care: Paneer rolls and mithai are everywhere this Diwali season. Buy sealed, chilled packs, and report bad food to 1800222365.
beats.what: On Monday, the FDA raided spots in Bavdhan, Kasba Peth and Bibwewadi. It seized paneer and khoya worth about ₹31 lakh.
beats.why: Officials said the stock was moved and stored without temperature control. Some paneer was sold unsealed in dirty conditions.

cards.body: Paneer came from three vehicles. The khoya was found at a dairy in Kasba Peth.
cards.caption: value of the paneer and khoya destroyed

cards.body: Bavdhan: 3,520 kg paneer. Kasba Peth: 3,235 kg paneer plus 720 kg khoya. Bibwewadi: 3,413 kg paneer. All were consignments from Karnataka.
cards.title: Where it was caught

opts: It was kept without temperature control
cards.q: Why did the FDA call this stock risky?
cards.why: Officials said the food was moved and stored at uncontrolled temperatures, which lets it spoil.

cards.q: Do you check paneer before buying?

hook: How much *suspect paneer* did Pune's FDA destroy in one morning?

learn.t: Maharashtra's FDA has a toll-free line, 1800222365, for complaints about food quality or hygiene.

sources.name: Punekar News
sources.title: Pune FDA Seizes 10,888 Kg Paneer, Khoya in Bavdhan, Kasba Peth and Bibwewadi

tldr: Pune's FDA seized and destroyed 10,888 kg of paneer and khoya it suspected was unsafe, brought in from Karnataka.
